summary: Sol-Gel Technologies Ltd. furnished a Form 6-K attaching a notice and proxy statement for its Annual Meeting of Shareholders scheduled November 17, 2026, at Greenberg Traurig's New York offices, with a record date of October 7, 2026. Shareholders will vote on appointing Kesselman Kesselman (PwC Israel) as independent auditors, re-electing Moshe Arkin, Itai Arkin, Hanna Lerman and Sharon Kochan as directors, re-electing external directors Ran Gottfried and Yuval Yanai, approving interim CEO and controlling shareholder Moshe Arkin as permanent CEO for three years from January 1, 2027, changing the company name, and increasing registered share capital. The board unanimously recommends all proposals. This is a routine meeting notice and proxy circular, not a special situation, though the controlling-shareholder CEO ratification and capital increase warrant governance attention.
